findings.title: `task unblock`/`task retry` delete `<id>-merge.log` without ever capturing it — a task blocked by `orchid merge`'s gate-exhaustion arm loses its only failure evidence at the recovery verb that arm recommends
`pack.sh`'s context.md arm has no `room <= 0` guard, so a budget-consuming `rework.md` makes it ship a zero-byte context.md recorded as delivered rather than omitted
the non-convergence block reason overruns `_DRIVE_QUOTE_MAX` (120) on the merge_gate arm once the task id is ≥8 characters, clipping the captured-log path mid-name

after `testing -> reviewing` resets `rework_signature_repeats` to 0 but keeps `rework_signature`, a returning identical failure is journalled as "identical to the previous round" while the brief tells the implementer it is "the first time this particular failure has been seen"
